violations.help: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space

nodes.summary: Fix any of the following: |   Target has insufficient size because it is partially obscured (smallest space is 328px by 8.7px, should be at least 24px by 24px) |   Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 16.8px instead of at least 24px.
